title: The Complete Drop Randomizer & Multiplier
description: Randomised drops with multiplied quantities. Reroll the shuffle manually. Set multiplier to x4, x16, or x64.
body:
# The Complete Drop Randomizer & Multiplier

Every block drops something completely unexpected — and you're getting more of it. Randomised drops with multiplied quantities in one pack. Reroll whenever you want and dial in your preferred drop count.

## Features
- **1000+ blocks** all have randomized drops
- **Mob drops** are randomized too
- **Fishing** drops are randomized too
- **256 possible drop configurations** — reroll as many times as you want with `/function randomizer:reroll`
- **x4, x16, x64** multiplier tiers — switch any time
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Start breaking things
4. Run `/function randomizer:reroll` whenever you want new mappings
5. Run `/function randomizer:set_x4`, `/function randomizer:set_x16` or `/function randomizer:set_x64` to change the multiplier

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack — no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
